def_en: to return something; to make you remember
note_ru: Два смысла: bring back the chairs и this song brings back memories.
example: Bring the ladder back when you're done.

examples_extra.en: This smell brings back my childhood.
examples_extra.ru: Этот запах возвращает меня в детство.

examples_extra.en: Could you bring back some milk?

def_en: to return goods; to admit you were wrong to say something
note_ru: I take it back — «беру свои слова обратно». Про товар — take it back to the shop.
example: I took the kettle back to the shop.

examples_extra.en: That was unfair - I take it back.
examples_extra.ru: Это было несправедливо — беру слова обратно.

examples_extra.en: You can take it back within thirty days.
examples_extra.ru: Вернуть можно в течение тридцати дней.

def_en: to give work to a teacher or boss
note_ru: Hand in an essay, hand in your notice — подать заявление об уходе.
example: Hand in your essays by Friday.

examples_extra.en: She handed in her notice yesterday.
examples_extra.ru: Вчера она подала заявление об уходе.

examples_extra.en: I handed the report in on time.

def_en: to give things to each person in a group
note_ru: Отсюда handout — раздаточный материал на занятии.
example: The teacher handed out the tests.

examples_extra.en: They were handing out free samples.
Can you hand these leaflets out?

def_en: to put something in the rubbish
note_ru: Throw away или throw out — одно и то же. Упустить шанс — тоже throw away a chance.
example: Don't throw away the receipt.

examples_extra.en: I threw away all my old notes.
examples_extra.ru: Я выбросил все свои старые конспекты.

examples_extra.en: He threw away a great opportunity.

def_en: to read something quickly
note_ru: Look through the report — бегло просмотреть. Внимательно изучить — go over.
example: I looked through the menu quickly.

examples_extra.en: Look through the notes before the exam.
She looked through the photos and smiled.

def_en: to check or explain something carefully
note_ru: Go over the plan — пройтись по плану пункт за пунктом. Часто перед экзаменом или встречей.
example: Let's go over the plan once more.
example_ru: Давайте ещё раз пройдёмся по плану.

examples_extra.en: The teacher went over the mistakes with us.
I'll go over the figures tonight.

def_en: to visit someone at their home
note_ru: Come over — «заходи к нам»: come over for dinner. Это и есть «прийти в гости».
example: Come over after work, we'll cook.

examples_extra.en: Some friends are coming over tonight.
examples_extra.ru: Сегодня вечером к нам зайдут друзья.

examples_extra.en: Can I come over at the weekend?

def_en: to contact someone later with an answer
note_ru: Рабочая классика: I'll get back to you — «я вернусь к вам с ответом».
example: I'll get back to you tomorrow.

examples_extra.en: She never got back to me about the price.
examples_extra.ru: Она так и не ответила мне насчёт цены.

examples_extra.en: Let me check and get back to you.
examples_extra.ru: Дайте я уточню и вернусь с ответом.

def_en: to start a journey
note_ru: Set off early — выехать пораньше. Ещё set off an alarm — случайно включить сигнализацию.
example: We set off at six in the morning.

examples_extra.en: They set off for the mountains on Friday.
examples_extra.ru: В пятницу они отправились в горы.

examples_extra.en: The smoke set off the fire alarm.

ru: пойти в кого-то, быть похожим на родню
def_en: to look or behave like an older relative
note_ru: Только про родственников: He takes after his father — он весь в отца.
example: She takes after her mother.

examples_extra.en: Who does the baby take after?
He takes after his grandad - same humour.
examples_extra.ru: Он весь в деда — тот же юмор.

def_en: to change from a child into an adult
note_ru: Grow up — про людей, grow — про растения и волосы. Where did you grow up? — где ты вырос?
example: I grew up in a small town.

examples_extra.en: She wants to be a vet when she grows up.
examples_extra.ru: Когда вырастет, она хочет стать ветеринаром.

examples_extra.en: Oh, grow up!

def_en: to arrive; to increase volume or heat
note_ru: He didn't turn up — он так и не пришёл. Turn up the music — сделай погромче.
example: She turned up an hour late.

examples_extra.en: Turn up the heating, it's freezing.
My keys turned up in the fridge.

def_en: to become something different
note_ru: The talk turned into an argument — разговор перерос в ссору.
example: The party turned into a disaster.

examples_extra.en: The hobby turned into a business.
Rain turned into snow by evening.
examples_extra.ru: К вечеру дождь перешёл в снег.

def_en: to meet by chance; to experience a problem
note_ru: Run into an old friend — столкнуться со знакомым. Run into problems — напороться на проблемы.
example: I ran into Anna at the airport.
example_ru: Я случайно встретил Анну в аэропорту.

examples_extra.en: We ran into a few problems with the visa.
examples_extra.ru: Мы столкнулись с парой проблем с визой.

examples_extra.en: You'll never guess who I ran into today.
examples_extra.ru: Ни за что не угадаешь, кого я сегодня встретил.

def_en: to remove; to invite somewhere; to arrange a loan or insurance
note_ru: Take out the rubbish — вынести мусор. Take her out — сводить её в ресторан. Take out a loan — взять кредит.
example: Can you take out the rubbish?

examples_extra.en: He took us out for pizza.
They took out a loan for the car.

def_en: to test something to see if it works
note_ru: Try out — испытать в деле: try out a new app. Try on — только про одежду.
example: I want to try out the new café.

examples_extra.en: We tried out three different routes.
Try the feature out and tell me.

def_en: to spend time improving or making something
note_ru: I'm working on it — «я этим занимаюсь», универсальный рабочий ответ.
example: She's working on a new book.

examples_extra.en: I need to work on my pronunciation.
We're still working on the details.

def_en: to give something for free; to reveal a secret
note_ru: Give away old clothes — раздать вещи. Don't give away the ending! — не спойлери!
example: We gave away most of our furniture.

examples_extra.en: His smile gave him away.
They're giving away free tickets.

def_en: to end a relationship
note_ru: Break up with someone — расстаться с кем-то. Группа распалась — the band broke up.
example: They broke up after five years.

examples_extra.en: She broke up with him by text.
examples_extra.ru: Она рассталась с ним по смс.

examples_extra.en: The meeting broke up at noon.

def_en: to invent a story; to become friends again; to form
note_ru: Три смысла: make up a story, they made up after the row, women make up half the team.
example: He made up an excuse about traffic.

examples_extra.en: Let's kiss and make up.
Students make up most of the audience.

def_en: to spend relaxed time with people
note_ru: Неформальное: hang out with friends. Where do you hang out? — где ты обычно бываешь?
example: We hung out at the park all day.
example_ru: Мы весь день тусовались в парке.

examples_extra.en: Want to hang out on Saturday?
He hangs out with the design team.
examples_extra.ru: Он много общается с командой дизайна.

def_en: to wait a moment; to keep holding something
note_ru: Hold on a second — секундочку. По телефону: hold on, please — оставайтесь на линии.
example: Hold on, I'll check the calendar.

examples_extra.en: Hold on tight, the road is bumpy.
Can you hold on a minute?

def_en: to happen; to continue
note_ru: What's going on? — «что происходит?». Go on! — «продолжай!» или «да ладно!».
example: What's going on here?

examples_extra.en: The show went on despite the rain.
Go on, I'm listening.

def_en: to appear or be mentioned unexpectedly
note_ru: Something came up — «кое-что случилось», вежливая причина отменить планы.
example: Sorry, something came up at work.

examples_extra.en: Your name came up in the meeting.
The question comes up every year.

def_en: to take someone or something to a place by car
note_ru: Drop me off at the corner — высади меня на углу. Противоположность pick up.
example: I'll drop you off at the station.

examples_extra.en: She drops the kids off at eight.
Can you drop off the documents on your way?

def_en: to be careful
note_ru: Watch out! — «берегись!». Watch out for pickpockets — остерегайся карманников.
example: Watch out! The floor is wet.

examples_extra.en: Watch out for ice on the steps.
Drivers should watch out for cyclists here.
